name: Collapsible Sidebar
details: A standard collapsible sidebar component with icon + label navigation items, section grouping, badge counts, user profile display, and collapse/expand functionality. Collapses to icon-only mode.
instructions: Import: import Sidebar, { type NavSection } from './components/Sidebar'
Define sections: const sections: NavSection[] = [{ id: 'main', items: [...] }]
Use: <Sidebar sections={sections} activeId={...} collapsed={collapsed} onToggleCollapse={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)} />
patterns: NavItem: { id, label, icon, path?, badge? }
user={{ name, email, imageUrl, role }} → profile at bottom
